subject: Follow-up: Redwood quote & procurement / invoicing details
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-corp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood quote & procurement / invoicing details

Hi Olivia — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Summary: Acme is evaluating Redwood for inference serving (hosted + dedicated capacity). You indicated procurement will likely use a PO rather than card for initial purchase.
- Ask for procurement: can you confirm whether you plan to purchase via PO (internal paper process) or prefer card/marketplace? If PO, does your team require a Master Services Agreement or is the standard order/quote sufficient?
- Invoice requirements we need to confirm: net terms (Net 30/Net 60), invoice format (PDF with line-item breakdown and PO number), VAT/tax handling (we can include VAT id and show tax breakdown), and billing address for remit.

Attachment: redwood_standard_quote.pdf (standard quote / draft pricing)

Next steps proposed:
1) If PO path: please share your PO template or confirm fields we should include (PO number, billing address, contact).
2) If marketplace interest: let us know if you prefer to transact via AWS Marketplace — we can provide pricing and advise on differences.
3) We will produce a final quote and DocuSign link once billing details are confirmed.

Thanks — I’ve cc'd Michael from finance/ops to help with invoice formatting and net terms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
redwood_standard_quote.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood quote & procurement / invoicing details

Thanks Marissa — good call this afternoon. A few answers from procurement: 

- Procurement path: we intend to use a PO for the initial purchase.
- Net terms: Net 30 is preferred.
- Invoice format: PDF invoice with PO number displayed, line-item pricing, and subtotals. We also need VAT broken out separately for EU entities.
- Billing address / VAT: Please invoice to:
  Acme Corp EU AB
  VAT ID: EU999888777
  Billing address: 12 Europa Plaza, Dublin, Ireland, D02 ABC1

I’m attaching our PO template so you can see required fields. We will issue a PO number after internal approvals (aiming to confirm by next week).

Also, we are interested in marketplace options (AWS) — can you confirm whether Redwood is listed and whether purchasing via marketplace affects invoicing or pricing?

Attachment: acme_po_template.pdf

Olivia Chen
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
olivia.chen@acme-corp.com

On Tue, Jul 28, 2026 at 3:10 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> [see below]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood quote & procurement / invoicing details

Thanks for the quick response, Olivia — that all makes sense. 

We’ll proceed with the PO path + Net 30. Dev / Michael — can you confirm finance is ok to issue an invoice to the EU entity with VAT breakdown and that we can accept a PO for this deal? Any required vendor paperwork (W-9, supplier form) for Acme EU?

Olivia — we’ll update the quote to include the VAT line and the billing address you provided, and we’ll send a final quote + DocuSign for signature once vendor paperwork is confirmed. Estimated timeline: final quote today or tomorrow; DocuSign to follow.

I’m attaching a completed vendor form draft for your team to review — if you need us to submit a specific supplier onboarding form, please forward.

Attachment: vendor_form_filled.docx

Best,
Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Redwood quote & procurement / invoicing details

Marissa — confirmed, Finance can accept PO with Net 30 for Acme pending a quick onboarding check. We will: 
- Include PO number as a required field on the invoice PDF.
- Show VAT as its own line (we can include VAT ID).
- Produce invoice with line items matching the quote; PDF will be emailed to the billing contact and available for download from our billing portal.

Questions for procurement: do you require a paper-signed invoice mailed to the Dublin address, or is an emailed PDF sufficient for remit? Also, if Acme needs any specific invoice reference fields populated (cost center, internal GL), please provide those mappings.

I’ll prepare the final invoice template and the DocuSign package after we receive the PO number.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Redwood quote & procurement / invoicing details

Hi Marissa / Dev —

We will proceed with issuing a PO. Expected timing: internal approvals complete by end of next week; we will share the PO number as soon as it’s approved. 

A few clarifications: 
- Emailed PDF invoice is fine; no paper mailing required.
- Please include the following reference fields on the invoice when possible: Cost Center: CLOUD-ENG-02, Project Code: ML-INF-2026.
- For marketplace: we are open to buying through AWS Marketplace, but please confirm whether pricing and contract terms are identical (we prefer marketplace if it preserves the same pricing and allows faster procurement).

We’ll send the PO template populated once approvals are complete.

Thanks,
Procurement Team (on behalf of Olivia Chen)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-corp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood quote & procurement / invoicing details

Perfect — thanks for the clarity. Final next steps from our side: 
1) I will update the attached quote to include VAT breakdown, billing address, and the reference fields (Cost Center / Project Code).
2) I’ll send a DocuSign link for signature (SOW/Order) once you confirm vendor onboarding details; Dev will prepare the invoice template matching the PO fields.
3) Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace. Purchasing via marketplace is possible; pricing is the same for the quoted SKU but the purchasing flow is slightly different (AWS handles invoicing/terms depending on your Marketplace agreement). If you prefer marketplace, we can introduce you to our marketplace specialist to confirm the fastest procurement path.

If you can share the PO number when available and the exact billing contact email for remit, we’ll finalize everything.

DocuSign (example link): https://docusign.com/example/ABC123
Marketplace listing: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/B0EXAMPLE

Looking forward — happy to jump on a short call if that helps speed approvals.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
